description.value:
Augmentations and self-modifications are common throughout the galaxy, but a cyborg takes this a step further, replacing at least half of their original body with augmentations.

Your body has been substantially augmented with cybernetic modifications, well beyond standard augmentation procedures. You gain the cyborg and tech traits, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. Your body has an integrated comm unit you can operate by thought alone, even making calls and taking photos without audibly speaking or moving. This doesn't count as an augmentation. Your implant limit is increased by 4. You can choose from cyborg feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
